internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service High Error Rate Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:04 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for the cart service due to a high error rate of 50%. Initial diagnosis identified error injection as the primary cause, supported by elevated error metrics and latency issues. Resource exhaustion was ruled out based on moderate CPU and minimal memory usage.

At 11:23 UTC, the mitigation action to disable the 'cartFailure' flag was proposed, approved, and executed promptly. Post-action monitoring confirmed recovery with error rates dropping to normal levels (0.2%).

The incident was resolved successfully with no ongoing impact. Further analysis and lessons learned are documented below.

external.title: Some customers experienced issues with cart service
external.body: Between 11:04 and 11:24 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced issues with the cart service resulting in errors during their shopping experience. The issue was identified and resolved promptly, restoring normal service operation. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
